answer: Anchor each identity to one real household internet line. First, onboarding needs a signed attestation from a residential ISP confirming one unique subscriber line per household. Second, the ISP re-signs it each epoch, and a line backing two identities is blacklisted. Third, traffic is sampled against a basalt-hard profile of one home, not a data center. A caught line loses its deposit and identities. Renting 1,000 separate residential lines costs about 600,000 dollars a year. A fake fleet with no real voyage behind it stands out, while honest agents rest in their own quiet lagoon.
